pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many strokes does 上 have? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 5

2. What should you check on your display before a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only the size
   C. Only the colour
   D. Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing

3. What does 没有 (méiyǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. There is not
   C. Sun
   D. It rains

4. Which Chinese word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. 蜡烛 làzhú
   B. 祝 zhù
   C. 盘子 pánzi
   D. 月 yuè

5. What does 刀 (dāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. Candle
   C. Knife
   D. Month

6. Why does repetition help your reading? (1 mark)
   A. It builds smooth, fluent reading
   B. It removes tones
   C. It erases the words
   D. It makes the text shorter

7. What does 天 (tiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. Rain
   C. Sky, day
   D. Drought

8. Which word is pronounced shàngmiàn? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发
   B. 上面
   C. 冰箱
   D. 放

9. What does 牛肉 (niúròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flat bread
   B. Water
   C. Beef
   D. Vegetables

10. What does 星期四 (xīngqīsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To go
   B. Seven
   C. Thursday
   D. Three

11. Which word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 上面 shàngmiàn
   B. 下面 xiàmiàn
   C. 左边 zuǒbian
   D. 右边 yòubian

12. Which Chinese word means "tea"? (1 mark)
   A. 喝 hē
   B. 葡萄 pútao
   C. 午饭 wǔfàn
   D. 茶 chá

13. What is the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. A tone that falls sharply
   B. A tone that rises high
   C. A light, short tone written without a mark
   D. A very loud tone

14. Which Chinese word means "which number, how many"? (1 mark)
   A. 唱歌 chànggē
   B. 朋友 péngyou
   C. 送 sòng
   D. 几 jǐ

15. What is the word order of a simple location sentence in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Place + thing + 在
   B. Thing + 在 + place
   C. Thing + place + 在
   D. 在 + thing + place

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone. (3 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is the sun." (2 marks)

18. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 前面. (2 marks)

19. Punctuate the sentences: 你好 (greeting), 我叫小明 (statement), 你呢 (question). Write the full sentences. (2 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喝 and 牙. (2 marks)

21. Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 3
   上 has three strokes.

2. D — Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing
   Careful checking makes the display clear.

3. B — There is not
   没有 (méiyǒu) means there is not.

4. C — 盘子 pánzi
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

5. C — Knife
   刀 (dāo) means knife.

6. A — It builds smooth, fluent reading
   Repeated reading builds fluency.

7. C — Sky, day
   天 (tiān) means sky, day.

8. B — 上面
   上面 is pronounced shàngmiàn and means above.

9. C — Beef
   牛肉 (niúròu) means beef.

10. C — Thursday
   星期四 (xīngqīsì) means Thursday.

11. C — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 is the left side.

12. D — 茶 chá
   茶 (chá) means tea.

13. C — A light, short tone written without a mark
   The neutral tone is light and short, as in the second syllable of māma.

14. D — 几 jǐ
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

15. B — Thing + 在 + place
   For example 冰箱在厨房.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct marks, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four with names.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是太阳。 zhè shì tàiyáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two correct marks, 2 marks for all three.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喝: hē, to drink. 牙: yá, tooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each explained point.
